import json,time,resource
import vail as hl
MODE=MODE_VALUE
N=N_VALUE
PARAM=PARAM_VALUE
hl.reset_global_randomness()
if MODE=='dag':
 t=time.perf_counter();x=hl.int32(1)
 for _ in range(N): x=x+x
 d=hl.dict(hl.array([hl.tuple([0,x]),hl.tuple([0,x+1])]))
 construction=time.perf_counter()-t
 assert d.dtype==hl.tdict(hl.tint32,hl.tint32)
 result={'construction_seconds':construction}
elif MODE=='dag_action':
 x=hl.int32(1)
 for _ in range(N):x=x+x
 d=hl.dict(hl.array([hl.tuple([0,x]),hl.tuple([0,x+1])]))
 t=time.perf_counter();actual=hl.eval(d)
 assert actual=={0:2**N+1}
 result={'action_seconds':time.perf_counter()-t}
else:
 if MODE=='extrema':
  table=hl.Table.parallelize([{'v':[float((i*104729)%N) for i in range(N)]}],schema=hl.tstruct(v=hl.tarray(hl.tfloat64)))
  values=hl.set(table.v)
  expression=hl.struct(lo=hl.min(values),hi=hl.max(values))
 elif MODE=='grouped':
  table=hl.Table.parallelize([{'v':list(range(N))}],schema=hl.tstruct(v=hl.tarray(hl.tint32)))
  expression=table.v.grouped(PARAM).length()
 elif MODE=='payload':
  table=hl.Table.parallelize([{'v':[hl.Struct(k=i%64,payload=str(i)+'x'*PARAM) for i in range(N)]}],
    schema=hl.tstruct(v=hl.tarray(hl.tstruct(k=hl.tint32,payload=hl.tstr))))
  expression=hl.group_by(lambda x:x.k,table.v)
 elif MODE=='lookup':
  table=hl.range_table(PARAM,2)
  dictionary=hl.literal({i:i+1 for i in range(N)},hl.tdict(hl.tint32,hl.tint32))
  expression=dictionary.get(table.idx,-1)
 t=time.perf_counter();actual=expression.collect();elapsed=time.perf_counter()-t
 if MODE=='extrema':assert actual==[hl.Struct(lo=0.,hi=float(N-1))]
 elif MODE=='grouped':assert actual==[(N+PARAM-1)//PARAM]
 elif MODE=='payload':assert sum(len(group) for group in actual[0].values())==N
 elif MODE=='lookup':assert actual==[i+1 if i<N else -1 for i in range(PARAM)]
 result={'action_seconds':elapsed}
result['peak_rss_bytes']=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
print(json.dumps(result))
limitations: Single bounded runs; peak RSS includes the Python runtime and input preparation.
DAG construction and action timings are distinct; generic lowering can still expand shared DAGs.
Array-column grouping shares element buffers. A scalar array with dynamic per-row sizes is broadcast by into_array(rows); no universal zero-copy claim.
Floating set sum/product retain existing sorted input order and SQL arithmetic.
